492:                 continue;
493:             }
494: 
495:             if ($token->equals('(')) {
496:                 ++$bracesLevel;
497: 
498:                 continue;
499:             }
500: 
501:             if ($token->equals(')')) {
502:                 --$bracesLevel;
503: 
504:                 continue;
505:             }
506: 
507:             if ($token->equals('{')) {

509: 
510:                 continue;
511:             }

/**
 * Fixer for constants case.
 *
 * @author Pol Dellaiera <pol.dellaiera@protonmail.com>
 */
final class ConstantCaseFixer extends AbstractFixer implements ConfigurableFixerInterface
{
    /**
     * Hold the function that will be used to convert the constants.
     *
     * @var callable
     */
    private $fixFunction;

    /**
     * @var array<string, true>
     */
    private array $functionTypeHints = [];

    /**
     * @var list<array{int}|string>
     */
    private array $beforePropertyTypeTokens = [];

    private FunctionsAnalyzer $typeDeclarationFunctionsAnalyzer;

    /**
     * @var array<string, true>
     */
    private array $classConstSupportedHints = [];

    /**
     * @var array<string, true>
     */

    private ?Tokens $typeDeclarationTokens = null;

    /**
     * @var array<int, array{classIndex: int, token: Token, type: string}>
     */

    /**
     * @var array<string, true>
     */
    private array $constantsToEscape = [];

    /**
     * @var array<string, true>
     */
    private array $caseInsensitiveConstantsToEscape = [];

    /**
     * @var array<string, mixed>
     */
    private array $constantInvocationConfiguration = [];

    /**
     * @var array<string, true>
     */
    private array $importedConstantShortNames = [];

    private ?Tokens $constantInvocationTokens = null;

    private ?GotoLabelAnalyzer $gotoLabelAnalyzer = null;

    private FunctionsAnalyzer $constantInvocationFunctionsAnalyzer;

    /**
     * @var array<string, string>
     */
    private array $magicMethodNames = [];

    private ?Tokens $magicCasingTokens = null;

    private int $magicMethodClassDepth = 0;

    /**
     * @var array<string, string>
     */
    private array $nativeFunctionNames = [];

    private FunctionsAnalyzer $nativeFunctionCasingAnalyzer;

    private ?Tokens $nativeFunctionTokens = null;

    /**
     * @var array<int, string>
     */
    private array $magicConstants = [];

    /**
     * @var list<int>
     */
    private array $magicConstantTokensList = [];

    private ?Tokens $staticReferenceTokens = null;

    /**
     * @var list<array{int, string}>
     */
    private array $staticReferenceCandidates = [];

    private ?Tokens $integerLiteralTokens = null;

    /**
     * @var array<int, string>
     */
    private array $integerLiteralReplacements = [];

    /**
     * @var array<string, list<Token>>
     */
    private array $functionToConstantMap = [];

    private ?Tokens $functionToConstantTokens = null;

    private ?Tokens $classyInvocationTokens = null;

    /**
     * @var list<int>
     */
    private array $classyInvocationForbiddenPrevKinds = [];

    private static ?self $sharedRuntime = null;

    public static function sharedRuntime(): self
    {
        if (null === self::$sharedRuntime) {
            self::$sharedRuntime = new self();
        }

        return self::$sharedRuntime;
    }

    public function configure(array $configuration): void
    {
        parent::configure($configuration);

        if ('lower' === $this->configuration['case']) {
            $this->fixFunction = static fn (string $content): string => strtolower($content);
        }

        if ('upper' === $this->configuration['case']) {
            $this->fixFunction = static fn (string $content): string => strtoupper($content);
        }
    }

    public function getDefinition(): FixerDefinitionInterface
    {
        return new FixerDefinition(
            'The PHP constants `true`, `false`, and `null` MUST be written using the correct casing.',
            [
                new CodeSample("<?php\n\$a = FALSE;\n\$b = True;\n\$c = nuLL;\n"),
                new CodeSample("<?php\n\$a = FALSE;\n\$b = True;\n\$c = nuLL;\n", ['case' => 'upper']),
            ]
        );
    }

    public function isCandidate(Tokens $tokens): bool
    {
        return $tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_STRING);
    }

    protected function createConfigurationDefinition(): FixerConfigurationResolverInterface
    {
        return new FixerConfigurationResolver([
            (new FixerOptionBuilder('case', 'Whether to use the `upper` or `lower` case syntax.'))
                ->setAllowedValues(['upper', 'lower'])
                ->setDefault('lower')
                ->getOption(),
        ]);
    }

    protected function applyFix(\SplFileInfo $file, Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $fixFunction = $this->fixFunction;

        foreach ($tokens as $index => $token) {
            if (!$token->isNativeConstant()) {
                continue;
            }

            if (
                $this->isNeighbourAccepted($tokens, $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index))
                && $this->isNeighbourAccepted($tokens, $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index))
                && !$this->isEnumCaseName($tokens, $index)
            ) {
                $tokens[$index] = new Token([$token->getId(), $fixFunction($token->getContent())]);
            }
        }
    }

    private function isNeighbourAccepted(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        static $forbiddenTokens = null;

        if (null === $forbiddenTokens) {
            $forbiddenTokens = [
                T_AS,
                T_CLASS,
                T_CONST,
                T_EXTENDS,
                T_IMPLEMENTS,
                T_INSTANCEOF,
                T_INSTEADOF,
                T_INTERFACE,
                T_NEW,
                T_NS_SEPARATOR,
                T_PAAMAYIM_NEKUDOTAYIM,
                T_TRAIT,
                T_USE,
                CT::T_USE_TRAIT,
                CT::T_USE_LAMBDA,
                ...Token::getObjectOperatorKinds(),
            ];
        }

        $token = $tokens[$index];

        if ($token->equalsAny(['{', '}'])) {
            return false;
        }

        return !$token->isGivenKind($forbiddenTokens);
    }

    private function isEnumCaseName(Tokens $tokens, int $index): bool
    {
        if (!\defined('T_ENUM') || !$tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_ENUM)) { // @TODO: drop condition when PHP 8.1+ is required
            return false;
        }

        $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);

        if (null === $prevIndex || !$tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_CASE)) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!$tokens->isTokenKindFound(T_SWITCH)) {
            return true;
        }

        $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevTokenOfKind($prevIndex, [[T_ENUM], [T_SWITCH]]);

        return null !== $prevIndex && $tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_ENUM);
    }

    public function applyNativeTypeDeclarationCasing(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->typeDeclarationTokens = $tokens;
        $this->ensureTypeDeclarationState();
        $this->fixFunctions();
        $this->fixClassConstantsAndProperties();
    }

    private function ensureTypeDeclarationState(): void
    {
        if (null === $this->typeDeclarationTokens) {
            return;
        }

        $this->beforePropertyTypeTokens = ['{', ';', [T_PRIVATE], [T_PROTECTED], [T_PUBLIC], [T_VAR]];
        $this->functionTypeHints = [
            'array' => true,
            'bool' => true,
            'callable' => true,
            'float' => true,
            'int' => true,
            'iterable' => true,
            'object' => true,
            'self' => true,
            'string' => true,
            'void' => true,
        ];
        $this->classConstSupportedHints = [
            'array' => true,
            'bool' => true,
            'float' => true,
            'int' => true,
            'iterable' => true,
            'mixed' => true,
            'null' => true,
            'object' => true,
            'parent' => true,
            'self' => true,
            'string' => true,
            'static' => true,
        ];
        $this->classPropertySupportedHints = [
            'array' => true,
            'bool' => true,
            'float' => true,
            'int' => true,
            'iterable' => true,
            'mixed' => true,
            'null' => true,
            'object' => true,
            'parent' => true,
            'self' => true,
            'static' => true,
            'string' => true,
        ];

        if (\PHP_VERSION_ID >= 8_00_00) {
            $this->functionTypeHints['false'] = true;
            $this->functionTypeHints['mixed'] = true;
            $this->functionTypeHints['null'] = true;
            $this->functionTypeHints['static'] = true;
        }

        if (\PHP_VERSION_ID >= 8_01_00) {
            $this->functionTypeHints['never'] = true;
            $this->beforePropertyTypeTokens[] = [T_READONLY];
        }

        if (\PHP_VERSION_ID >= 8_02_00) {
            $this->functionTypeHints['true'] = true;
        }

        $this->typeDeclarationFunctionsAnalyzer = new FunctionsAnalyzer();
        $this->classyElementsBuffer = [];
    }

    private function fixFunctions(): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return;
        }

        for ($index = $tokens->count() - 1; $index >= 0; --$index) {
            if ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind([T_FUNCTION, T_FN])) {
                $this->fixFunctionReturnType($index);
                $this->fixFunctionArgumentTypes($index);
            }
        }
    }

    private function fixFunctionArgumentTypes(int $index): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return;
        }

        foreach ($this->typeDeclarationFunctionsAnalyzer->getFunctionArguments($tokens, $index) as $argument) {
            $this->fixArgumentType($argument->getTypeAnalysis());
        }
    }

    private function fixFunctionReturnType(int $index): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return;
        }

        $this->fixArgumentType($this->typeDeclarationFunctionsAnalyzer->getFunctionReturnType($tokens, $index));
    }

    private function fixArgumentType(?TypeAnalysis $type = null): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $type || null === $tokens) {
            return;
        }

        for ($index = $type->getStartIndex(); $index <= $type->getEndIndex(); ++$index) {
            $nextIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
            if (null !== $nextIndex && $tokens[$nextIndex]->isGivenKind(T_NS_SEPARATOR)) {
                continue;
            }

            $this->fixNativeTypeCasing($this->functionTypeHints, $index);
        }
    }

    private function fixClassConstantsAndProperties(): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return;
        }

        $elements = array_reverse($this->collectClassyElements(), true);

        foreach ($elements as $index => $element) {
            if ('const' === $element['type']) {
                if (\PHP_VERSION_ID >= 8_03_00 && !$this->isConstWithoutType($index)) {
                    foreach ($this->getNativeTypeHintCandidatesForConstant($index) as $nativeTypeHintIndex) {
                        $this->fixNativeTypeCasing($this->classConstSupportedHints, $nativeTypeHintIndex);
                    }
                }

                continue;
            }

            if ('property' === $element['type']) {
                foreach ($this->getNativeTypeHintCandidatesForProperty($index) as $nativeTypeHintIndex) {
                    $this->fixNativeTypeCasing($this->classPropertySupportedHints, $nativeTypeHintIndex);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, array{classIndex: int, token: Token, type: string}>
     */
    private function collectClassyElements(): array
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return [];
        }

        $this->classyElementsBuffer = [];

        for ($index = 1, $count = \count($tokens) - 2; $index < $count; ++$index) {
            if ($tokens[$index]->isClassy()) {
                [$index, $newElements] = $this->findClassyElements($index, $index);
                $this->classyElementsBuffer += $newElements;
            }
        }

        ksort($this->classyElementsBuffer);

        return $this->classyElementsBuffer;
    }

    /**
     * @return array{int, array<int, array{classIndex: int, token: Token, type: string}>}
     */
    private function findClassyElements(int $classIndex, int $index): array
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        $elements = [];
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return [$index, $elements];
        }

        $curlyBracesLevel = 0;
        $bracesLevel = 0;
        ++$index;

        for ($count = \count($tokens); $index < $count; ++$index) {
            $token = $tokens[$index];

            if ($token->isGivenKind(T_ENCAPSED_AND_WHITESPACE)) {
                continue;
            }

            if ($token->isGivenKind(T_CLASS)) {
                $nestedResult = $this->findNestedAnonymousClassElements($index);
                $index = $nestedResult[0];
                $elements += $nestedResult[1];

                continue;
            }

            if ($token->equals('(')) {
                ++$bracesLevel;

                continue;
            }

            if ($token->equals(')')) {
                --$bracesLevel;

                continue;
            }

            if ($token->equals('{')) {
                ++$curlyBracesLevel;

                continue;
            }

            if ($token->equals('}')) {
                --$curlyBracesLevel;

                if (0 === $curlyBracesLevel) {
                    break;
                }

                continue;
            }

            if (1 !== $curlyBracesLevel || !$token->isArray()) {
                continue;
            }

            $classified = $this->classifyClassyElement($classIndex, $index, $bracesLevel, $token);
            if (null !== $classified) {
                $elements[$index] = $classified;
            }
        }

        return [$index, $elements];
    }

    /**
     * @return array{int, array<int, array{classIndex: int, token: Token, type: string}>}
     */
    private function findNestedAnonymousClassElements(int $index): array
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        $elements = [];
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return [$index, $elements];
        }

        $nestedClassIndex = $index;
        $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        $count = \count($tokens);

        if ($tokens[$index]->equals('(')) {
            ++$index;

            for ($nestedBracesLevel = 1; $index < $count; ++$index) {
                $token = $tokens[$index];

                if ($token->equals('(')) {
                    ++$nestedBracesLevel;

                    continue;
                }

                if ($token->equals(')')) {
                    --$nestedBracesLevel;

                    if (0 === $nestedBracesLevel) {
                        [$index, $newElements] = $this->findClassyElements($nestedClassIndex, $index);
                        $elements += $newElements;

                        break;
                    }

                    continue;
                }

                if ($token->isGivenKind(T_CLASS)) {
                    [$index, $newElements] = $this->findClassyElements($index, $index);
                    $elements += $newElements;
                }
            }
        } else {
            [$index, $newElements] = $this->findClassyElements($nestedClassIndex, $nestedClassIndex);
            $elements += $newElements;
        }

        return [$index, $elements];
    }

    /**
     * @return null|array{classIndex: int, token: Token, type: string}
     */
    private function classifyClassyElement(int $classIndex, int $index, int $bracesLevel, Token $token): ?array
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return null;
        }

        if (0 === $bracesLevel && $token->isGivenKind(T_VARIABLE)) {
            return [
                'classIndex' => $classIndex,
                'token' => $token,
                'type' => 'property',
            ];
        }

        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_FUNCTION)) {
            return [
                'classIndex' => $classIndex,
                'token' => $token,
                'type' => 'method',
            ];
        }

        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_CONST)) {
            return [
                'classIndex' => $classIndex,
                'token' => $token,
                'type' => 'const',
            ];
        }

        if ($token->isGivenKind(CT::T_USE_TRAIT)) {
            return [
                'classIndex' => $classIndex,
                'token' => $token,
                'type' => 'trait_import',
            ];
        }

        if ($token->isGivenKind(T_CASE)) {
            return [
                'classIndex' => $classIndex,
                'token' => $token,
                'type' => 'case',
            ];
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<int>
     */
    private function getNativeTypeHintCandidatesForConstant(int $index): iterable
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return;
        }

        $constNameIndex = $this->getConstNameIndex($index);
        $index = $this->getFirstIndexOfType($index);
        $typeSeparationKinds = [
            CT::T_TYPE_ALTERNATION,
            CT::T_TYPE_INTERSECTION,
            CT::T_DISJUNCTIVE_NORMAL_FORM_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_OPEN,
            CT::T_DISJUNCTIVE_NORMAL_FORM_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_CLOSE,
        ];

        do {
            $typeEnd = $this->getTypeEnd($index, $constNameIndex);

            if ($typeEnd === $index) {
                yield $index;
            }

            do {
                $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
            } while (null !== $index && $tokens[$index]->isGivenKind($typeSeparationKinds));
        } while (null !== $index && $index < $constNameIndex);
    }

    private function isConstWithoutType(int $index): bool
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return true;
        }

        $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        if (null === $index) {
            return true;
        }

        $nextIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);

        return $tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_STRING) && null !== $nextIndex && $tokens[$nextIndex]->equals('=');
    }

    private function getConstNameIndex(int $index): int
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return $index;
        }

        return $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken(
            $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($index, ['=']),
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<int>
     */
    private function getNativeTypeHintCandidatesForProperty(int $index): iterable
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return;
        }

        $propertyNameIndex = $index;
        $index = $tokens->getPrevTokenOfKind($index, $this->beforePropertyTypeTokens);
        $index = $this->getFirstIndexOfType($index);
        $typeSeparationKinds = [
            CT::T_TYPE_ALTERNATION,
            CT::T_TYPE_INTERSECTION,
            CT::T_DISJUNCTIVE_NORMAL_FORM_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_OPEN,
            CT::T_DISJUNCTIVE_NORMAL_FORM_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_CLOSE,
        ];

        do {
            $typeEnd = $this->getTypeEnd($index, $propertyNameIndex);

            if ($typeEnd === $index) {
                yield $index;
            }

            do {
                $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
            } while (null !== $index && $tokens[$index]->isGivenKind($typeSeparationKinds));
        } while (null !== $index && $index < $propertyNameIndex);
    }

    private function getFirstIndexOfType(int $index): int
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return $index;
        }

        $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);

        if (null !== $index && $tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(CT::T_NULLABLE_TYPE)) {
            $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        }

        if (null !== $index && $tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(CT::T_DISJUNCTIVE_NORMAL_FORM_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_OPEN)) {
            $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        }

        return (int) $index;
    }

    private function getTypeEnd(int $index, int $upperLimit): int
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return $index;
        }

        if (!$tokens[$index]->isGivenKind([T_STRING, T_NS_SEPARATOR])) {
            return $index;
        }

        $endIndex = $index;
        while ($tokens[$index]->isGivenKind([T_STRING, T_NS_SEPARATOR]) && $index < $upperLimit) {
            $endIndex = $index;
            $index = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
            if (null === $index) {
                break;
            }
        }

        return $endIndex;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, true> $supportedTypeHints
     */
    private function fixNativeTypeCasing(array $supportedTypeHints, int $index): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->typeDeclarationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens || !isset($tokens[$index])) {
            return;
        }

        $typeContent = $tokens[$index]->getContent();
        $typeContentLower = strtolower($typeContent);

        if (isset($supportedTypeHints[$typeContentLower]) && $typeContent !== $typeContentLower) {
            $tokens[$index] = new Token([$tokens[$index]->getId(), $typeContentLower]);
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $configuration
     * @param array<string, true>  $constantsToEscape
     * @param array<string, true>  $caseInsensitiveConstantsToEscape
     */
    public function applyNativeConstantInvocationFix(
        Tokens $tokens,
        array $configuration,
        array $constantsToEscape,
        array $caseInsensitiveConstantsToEscape
    ): void {
        $this->constantInvocationTokens = $tokens;
        $this->constantInvocationConfiguration = $configuration;
        $this->constantsToEscape = $constantsToEscape;
        $this->caseInsensitiveConstantsToEscape = $caseInsensitiveConstantsToEscape;
        $this->constantInvocationFunctionsAnalyzer = new FunctionsAnalyzer();
        $this->importedConstantShortNames = $this->constantInvocationFunctionsAnalyzer->getImportedConstantShortNames($tokens);
        $this->gotoLabelAnalyzer = null;

        if ('all' === $this->constantInvocationConfiguration['scope']) {
            $this->fixConstantInvocations(0, \count($tokens) - 1);

            return;
        }

        foreach (array_reverse($tokens->getNamespaceDeclarations()) as $namespace) {
            if ($namespace->isGlobalNamespace()) {
                continue;
            }

            $this->fixConstantInvocations($namespace->getScopeStartIndex(), $namespace->getScopeEndIndex());
        }
    }

    private function fixConstantInvocations(int $startIndex, int $endIndex): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->constantInvocationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return;
        }

        for ($index = $endIndex; $index > $startIndex; --$index) {
            $token = $tokens[$index];

            if (!$token->isGivenKind(T_STRING)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (!$this->isConstantInvocation($index)) {
                continue;
            }

            $this->processConstantInvocationCandidate($index, $token->getContent());
        }
    }

    private function processConstantInvocationCandidate(int $index, string $tokenContent): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->constantInvocationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return;
        }

        $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);
        if (null === $prevIndex) {
            return;
        }

        if (!isset($this->constantsToEscape[$tokenContent]) && !isset($this->caseInsensitiveConstantsToEscape[strtolower($tokenContent)])) {
            $this->maybeStripUnnecessaryNamespaceSeparator($index, $prevIndex);

            return;
        }

        if (isset($this->importedConstantShortNames[$tokenContent])) {
            return;
        }

        if ($tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_NS_SEPARATOR)) {
            return;
        }

        $tokens->insertAt($index, new Token([T_NS_SEPARATOR, '\\']));
    }

    private function maybeStripUnnecessaryNamespaceSeparator(int $index, int $prevIndex): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->constantInvocationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return;
        }

        if (false === $this->constantInvocationConfiguration['strict']) {
            return;
        }

        if (!$tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_NS_SEPARATOR)) {
            return;
        }

        $prevPrevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($prevIndex);
        if (null !== $prevPrevIndex && $tokens[$prevPrevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_STRING)) {
            return;
        }

        $tokens->clearTokenAndMergeSurroundingWhitespace($prevIndex);
    }

    private function isConstantInvocation(int $index): bool
    {
        $tokens = $this->constantInvocationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return false;
        }

        if (!$tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_STRING)) {
            return false;
        }

        $nextIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);
        if (null === $nextIndex) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($this->constantInvocationHasForbiddenNextToken($nextIndex)) {
            return false;
        }

        $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);
        if (null === $prevIndex) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($this->constantInvocationHasForbiddenPrevToken($prevIndex)) {
            return false;
        }

        while ($tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind([CT::T_NAMESPACE_OPERATOR, T_NS_SEPARATOR, T_STRING])) {
            $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($prevIndex);
            if (null === $prevIndex) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ($this->constantInvocationHasForbiddenResolvedPrevToken($prevIndex)) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($this->isFunctionReferenceParameter($prevIndex, $nextIndex)) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($this->isImportListConstantLookalike($prevIndex)) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($this->isQuotedStringArrayIndex($prevIndex, $nextIndex)) {
            return false;
        }

        if (AttributeAnalyzer::isAttribute($tokens, $index)) {
            return false;
        }

        if ($this->belongsToGotoLabel($nextIndex)) {
            return false;
        }

        return !$this->isNonCapturingCatchType($prevIndex);
    }

    private function constantInvocationHasForbiddenNextToken(int $nextIndex): bool
    {
        $tokens = $this->constantInvocationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return true;
        }

        return $tokens[$nextIndex]->equalsAny(['(', '{'])
            || $tokens[$nextIndex]->isGivenKind([
                T_AS,
                T_DOUBLE_COLON,
                T_ELLIPSIS,
                T_NS_SEPARATOR,
                CT::T_RETURN_REF,
                CT::T_TYPE_ALTERNATION,
                CT::T_TYPE_INTERSECTION,
                T_VARIABLE,
            ]);
    }

    private function constantInvocationHasForbiddenPrevToken(int $prevIndex): bool
    {
        $tokens = $this->constantInvocationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return true;
        }

        return $tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind([
            T_AS,
            T_CLASS,
            T_CONST,
            T_DOUBLE_COLON,
            T_FUNCTION,
            T_GOTO,
            CT::T_GROUP_IMPORT_BRACE_OPEN,
            T_INTERFACE,
            T_TRAIT,
            CT::T_TYPE_COLON,
            CT::T_TYPE_ALTERNATION,
            CT::T_TYPE_INTERSECTION,
        ]) || $tokens[$prevIndex]->isObjectOperator();
    }

    private function constantInvocationHasForbiddenResolvedPrevToken(int $prevIndex): bool
    {
        $tokens = $this->constantInvocationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return true;
        }

        return $tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind([
            CT::T_CONST_IMPORT,
            T_EXTENDS,
            CT::T_FUNCTION_IMPORT,
            T_IMPLEMENTS,
            T_INSTANCEOF,
            T_INSTEADOF,
            T_NAMESPACE,
            T_NEW,
            CT::T_NULLABLE_TYPE,
            CT::T_TYPE_COLON,
            T_USE,
            CT::T_USE_TRAIT,
            CT::T_TYPE_INTERSECTION,
            CT::T_TYPE_ALTERNATION,
            T_CONST,
            CT::T_DISJUNCTIVE_NORMAL_FORM_TYPE_PARENTHESIS_CLOSE,
        ]);
    }

    private function isFunctionReferenceParameter(int $prevIndex, int $nextIndex): bool
    {
        $tokens = $this->constantInvocationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return false;
        }

        $nextNextIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($nextIndex);
        if (!$tokens[$nextIndex]->equals('&') || null === $nextNextIndex || !$tokens[$nextNextIndex]->isGivenKind(T_VARIABLE)) {
            return false;
        }

        $checkIndex = $tokens->getPrevTokenOfKind($prevIndex, [';', '{', '}', [T_FUNCTION], [T_OPEN_TAG], [T_OPEN_TAG_WITH_ECHO]]);

        return null !== $checkIndex && $tokens[$checkIndex]->isGivenKind(T_FUNCTION);
    }

    private function isImportListConstantLookalike(int $prevIndex): bool
    {
        $tokens = $this->constantInvocationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens || !$tokens[$prevIndex]->equals(',')) {
            return false;
        }

        $checkIndex = $prevIndex;
        while ($tokens[$checkIndex]->equalsAny([',', [T_AS], [CT::T_NAMESPACE_OPERATOR], [T_NS_SEPARATOR], [T_STRING]])) {
            $checkIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($checkIndex);
            if (null === $checkIndex) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return $tokens[$checkIndex]->isGivenKind([T_EXTENDS, CT::T_GROUP_IMPORT_BRACE_OPEN, T_IMPLEMENTS, T_USE, CT::T_USE_TRAIT]);
    }

    private function isQuotedStringArrayIndex(int $prevIndex, int $nextIndex): bool
    {
        $tokens = $this->constantInvocationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens || !$tokens[$prevIndex]->equals('[') || !$tokens[$nextIndex]->equals(']')) {
            return false;
        }

        $checkTokenIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($nextIndex);
        if (null === $checkTokenIndex) {
            return false;
        }

        $checkToken = $tokens[$checkTokenIndex];

        return $checkToken->equals('"') || $checkToken->isGivenKind([T_CURLY_OPEN, T_DOLLAR_OPEN_CURLY_BRACES, T_ENCAPSED_AND_WHITESPACE, T_VARIABLE]);
    }

    private function belongsToGotoLabel(int $nextIndex): bool
    {
        $tokens = $this->constantInvocationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens || !$tokens[$nextIndex]->equals(':')) {
            return false;
        }

        if (null === $this->gotoLabelAnalyzer) {
            $this->gotoLabelAnalyzer = new GotoLabelAnalyzer();
        }

        return $this->gotoLabelAnalyzer->belongsToGoToLabel($tokens, $nextIndex);
    }

    private function isNonCapturingCatchType(int $prevIndex): bool
    {
        $tokens = $this->constantInvocationTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return false;
        }

        while ($tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind([CT::T_NAMESPACE_OPERATOR, T_NS_SEPARATOR, T_STRING, CT::T_TYPE_ALTERNATION])) {
            $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($prevIndex);
            if (null === $prevIndex) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if (!$tokens[$prevIndex]->equals('(')) {
            return false;
        }

        $prevPrevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($prevIndex);

        return null !== $prevPrevIndex && $tokens[$prevPrevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_CATCH);
    }

    public function applyMagicMethodCasing(Tokens $tokens): void
    {
        $this->magicCasingTokens = $tokens;
        $this->magicMethodClassDepth = 0;
        $this->ensureMagicMethodNames();

        $tokenCount = \count($tokens);
        for ($index = 1; $index < $tokenCount - 2; ++$index) {
            $index = $this->advanceMagicMethodClassContext($index);
            if (null === $this->magicCasingTokens) {
                return;
            }

            if (!$tokens[$index]->isGivenKind(T_STRING)) {
                continue;
            }

            $this->maybeFixMagicMethodName($index);
        }
    }

    private function ensureMagicMethodNames(): void
    {
        if ([] !== $this->magicMethodNames && null !== $this->magicCasingTokens) {
            return;
        }

        $this->magicMethodNames = [
            '__call' => '__call',
            '__callstatic' => '__callStatic',
            '__clone' => '__clone',
            '__construct' => '__construct',
            '__debuginfo' => '__debugInfo',
            '__destruct' => '__destruct',
            '__get' => '__get',
            '__invoke' => '__invoke',
            '__isset' => '__isset',
            '__serialize' => '__serialize',
            '__set' => '__set',
            '__set_state' => '__set_state',
            '__sleep' => '__sleep',
            '__tostring' => '__toString',
            '__unserialize' => '__unserialize',
            '__unset' => '__unset',
            '__wakeup' => '__wakeup',
        ];
    }

    private function advanceMagicMethodClassContext(int $index): int
    {
        $tokens = $this->magicCasingTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return $index;
        }

        if (0 === $this->magicMethodClassDepth && $tokens[$index]->isClassy()) {
            $this->magicMethodClassDepth = 1;
            $next = $tokens->getNextTokenOfKind($index, ['{']);

            return null === $next ? $index : $next;
        }

        if (0 !== $this->magicMethodClassDepth) {
            if ($tokens[$index]->equals('{')) {
                ++$this->magicMethodClassDepth;
            } elseif ($tokens[$index]->equals('}')) {
                --$this->magicMethodClassDepth;
            }
        }

        return $index;
    }

    private function maybeFixMagicMethodName(int $index): void
    {
        $tokens = $this->magicCasingTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return;
        }

        $content = $tokens[$index]->getContent();
        if (!str_starts_with($content, '__')) {
            return;
        }

        $name = strtolower($content);
        if (!$this->isMagicMethodName($name)) {
            return;
        }

        $nameInCorrectCasing = $this->getMagicMethodNameInCorrectCasing($name);
        if ($nameInCorrectCasing === $content) {
            return;
        }

        if ($this->isMagicFunctionSignature($index)) {
            if (0 !== $this->magicMethodClassDepth) {
                $this->setMagicMethodTokenCasing($index, $nameInCorrectCasing);
            }

            return;
        }

        if ($this->isMagicMethodCall($index)) {
            $this->setMagicMethodTokenCasing($index, $nameInCorrectCasing);

            return;
        }

        if (
            ('__callstatic' === $name || '__set_state' === $name)
            && $this->isMagicStaticMethodCall($index)
        ) {
            $this->setMagicMethodTokenCasing($index, $nameInCorrectCasing);
        }
    }

    private function isMagicFunctionSignature(int $index): bool
    {
        $tokens = $this->magicCasingTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return false;
        }

        $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);
        if (null === $prevIndex || !$tokens[$prevIndex]->isGivenKind(T_FUNCTION)) {
            return false;
        }

        $nextIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);

        return null !== $nextIndex && $tokens[$nextIndex]->equals('(');
    }

    private function isMagicMethodCall(int $index): bool
    {
        $tokens = $this->magicCasingTokens;
        if (null === $tokens) {
            return false;
        }

        $prevIndex = $tokens->getPrevMeaningfulToken($index);
        if (null === $prevIndex || !$tokens[$prevIndex]->isObjectOperator()) {
            return false;
        }

        $nextIndex = $tokens->getNextMeaningfulToken($index);

        return null !== $nextIndex && $tokens[$nextIndex]->equals('(');
    }

    private function isMagicStaticMethodCall(int $index): bool
    {
        $tokens = $this->magicCasingTokens;
